description.summary: the automatic tiling of a workspace

protocol.description:
Whether the compositor tiles the windows of a workspace of ext-workspace-v1 or leaves them floating, and the request that changes it, for the shell's tiling switch. The compositor offers the manager only to the clients it trusts with it; it is Athanor's own protocol (doc_own_stack.md OS5 and OS12).
A new version adds interfaces, requests, events or enum entries; a client binds the version it knows.

interface.name: athanor_workspace_tiling_manager_v1
interface.description: Makes the tiling object of a workspace.

entry.name: already_made
entry.summary: the client already has a tiling object of this workspace

request.name: destroy
request.description: The tiling objects made from the manager stay valid.

request.name: get_tiling
request.description: Makes the tiling object of the workspace an ext_workspace_handle_v1 stands for. Its state is sent at once; for a workspace already removed, removed is sent instead. A second tiling object of the same workspace, while the client holds a first that was not sent removed, is the already_made error.

interface.name: athanor_workspace_tiling_v1
interface.description: Whether a workspace is tiled, sent when the object is made and at each change, whatever made it.

entry.name: floating
entry.summary: the windows keep the places they are given

entry.name: tiled
entry.summary: the windows share the workspace in tiles

event.name: state
event.description: Whether the workspace is tiled. A new workspace is floating.

event.name: removed
event.description: The workspace was removed. The object sends nothing more and ignores set_state; the client destroys it.

request.name: set_state

description.summary: tile the workspace or float it

request.description: Tiles the workspace or lets its windows float again, at once. Tiled, each window the user can see takes a tile; floating again, each returns to the place and the size it had before. Every tiling object of the workspace is then sent state. A value that is not in the enum is ignored.
